tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Tool panels and the fader area. Sits on paper; never used for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body text and readout numbers on paper or panel (13.9:1 light, 15.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, disclosure lines (6.6:1 on paper light, 8.2:1 dark). Replaces the old steel grey, which failed contrast.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and unlit meter segments only. Too faint for control borders or text.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders on buttons, inputs and chips (4.1:1 light, 4.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand amber. Primary button fill, lit meter segments, the logo cable. Never text or thin lines on paper in light theme (2.1:1).

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed state.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (6.8:1).

tokens.name: savings
tokens.usage: Money or time saved: the stack meter and positive results (4.5:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: overload
tokens.usage: What a problem costs: the labor-burn meter, gain or phantom-power warnings, errors (5.0:1 light, 6.4:1 dark). Always paired with words, never color alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px with 2px offset.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Fader values and meter numbers. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Move the two faders to see what editing costs you.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: This mic needs 60 dB of clean gain. Your interface gives 56.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Labels, captions, disclosure. Never smaller than this on mobile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between meter segments and inline icon spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side margin on mobile; padding inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels; gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, meter segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the bottom-sheet modal.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Small status tags only, like 'checked Oct 28'.
